title: The Double Safehouse
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Theo Amberdale, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
